mapper.insert: INSERT INTO patient_profile (nickname, status, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{nickname}, #{status}, #{version}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})

INSERT INTO profile_access (account_id, profile_id, relationship, access_status, authorization_declared_at, declaration_version, revoked_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{profileId}, #{relationship}, #{accessStatus}, #{authorizationDeclaredAt}, #{declarationVersion}, #{revokedAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.sql: p.id AS profile_id, p.nickname, p.status, p.version, a.relationship, a.authorization_declared_at, a.declaration_version
mapper.select: SELECT FROM profile_access a JOIN patient_profile p ON p.id = a.profile_id WHERE a.account_id = #{accountId} AND a.access_status = 'ACTIVE'
